stops.note: one of the world's oldest ports, already named in Egyptian records of the 1400s BC; tradition links the name to 'yafe', beautiful
growers here developed the thick-skinned Shamouti orange in the mid-1800s, ideal for long sea voyages
shipped to Britain in huge numbers; McVitie's launched Jaffa Cakes in 1927

current_meaning: a large, thick-skinned sweet orange, named after the port of Jaffa
